comparison.objective: Secure a spring-loaded tote lid using a loose elastic strap; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1519 tests elastic-hook selection, stretching, bimanual restraint, and hook attachment; candidate is rigid-body tool use with collar adjustment and setscrew retention.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1519 requires release and a gap below 3 mm for 20 seconds, with overload/snap-back/penetration vetoes; candidate requires two safe impacts and low collar drift. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Spring restraint with an elastic element is mechanically and dexterously different from rigid damper commissioning.
